original: The South East Forests National Park is a national park located in between the Monaro and South Coast regions of New South Wales, Australia. The 115,177-hectare national park is situated 378 kilometres southwest of Sydney. It features high quality old growth eucalyptus forest and remnant patches of temperate rainforest.
